package student

import (
	"context"
	"errors"
	"testing"

	"github.com/example/ms-student-service/internal/domain"
	"github.com/example/ms-student-service/internal/domain/repository"
)

type materializationCatalogStub struct {
	runtimeContext domain.PracticeTaskRuntimeContext
	revisionID     string
}

func (stub materializationCatalogStub) GetRuntimeContext(context.Context, string) (*domain.PracticeTaskRuntimeContext, error) {
	copy := stub.runtimeContext
	return &copy, nil
}

func (stub materializationCatalogStub) GetPublishedRuntimeContext(context.Context, string) (*domain.PracticeTaskRuntimeContext, error) {
	copy := stub.runtimeContext
	return &copy, nil
}

func (stub materializationCatalogStub) GetRevisionRuntimeContext(_ context.Context, revisionID string) (*domain.PracticeTaskRuntimeContext, error) {
	if stub.revisionID != "" && revisionID != stub.revisionID {
		return nil, domain.ErrNotFound
	}
	copy := stub.runtimeContext
	return &copy, nil
}

func (stub materializationCatalogStub) GetRevisionEvaluationContext(context.Context, string) (*domain.PracticeTaskEvaluationContext, error) {
	return &domain.PracticeTaskEvaluationContext{}, nil
}

type materializationRepositoryStub struct {
	repository.StudentPracticeTaskRepository
	createdProject    domain.StudentPracticeTask
	createdMilestones []domain.StudentPracticeTaskMilestone
}

func (stub *materializationRepositoryStub) CreateStudentPracticeTask(_ context.Context, project domain.StudentPracticeTask, milestones []domain.StudentPracticeTaskMilestone) error {
	stub.createdProject = project
	stub.createdMilestones = append([]domain.StudentPracticeTaskMilestone(nil), milestones...)
	return nil
}

func (stub *materializationRepositoryStub) GetStudentPracticeTask(context.Context, string) (*domain.StudentPracticeTask, error) {
	copy := stub.createdProject
	return &copy, nil
}

func TestCreateStudentPracticeTaskSnapshotsCatalogIdentityAndSkipsInactiveMilestones(t *testing.T) {
	repositoryStub := &materializationRepositoryStub{}
	useCase := StudentUseCase{
		Catalog: materializationCatalogStub{runtimeContext: domain.PracticeTaskRuntimeContext{
			RevisionID: "revision-1",
			SolutionVariants: []domain.PracticeTaskRuntimeVariant{{
				ID:           "variant-html",
				Code:         "html",
				IsActive:     true,
				MilestoneIDs: []string{"part-milestone-active"},
			}},
			PracticeTaskMilestones: []domain.PracticeTaskRuntimeMilestone{
				{
					ID:                      "part-milestone-active",
					PracticeTaskPartID:      "part-active",
					PracticeTaskMilestoneID: "milestone-active",
					IsActive:                true,
				},
				{
					ID:                      "part-milestone-inactive",
					PracticeTaskPartID:      "part-inactive",
					PracticeTaskMilestoneID: "milestone-inactive",
					IsActive:                false,
				},
			},
		}},
		Students: repositoryStub,
	}

	_, err := useCase.CreateStudentPracticeTask(context.Background(), "student", "practice-task", "variant-html")
	if err != nil {
		t.Fatalf("create student practice task: %v", err)
	}
	if len(repositoryStub.createdMilestones) != 1 {
		t.Fatalf("expected one active milestone, got %#v", repositoryStub.createdMilestones)
	}
	created := repositoryStub.createdMilestones[0]
	if repositoryStub.createdProject.PracticeTaskRevisionID != "revision-1" {
		t.Fatalf("expected student runtime to pin revision-1, got %#v", repositoryStub.createdProject)
	}
	if repositoryStub.createdProject.PracticeTaskSolutionVariantID != "variant-html" {
		t.Fatalf("expected student runtime to pin variant-html, got %#v", repositoryStub.createdProject)
	}
	if created.PracticeTaskPartMilestoneID != "part-milestone-active" ||
		created.PracticeTaskPartID != "part-active" ||
		created.PracticeTaskMilestoneID != "milestone-active" {
		t.Fatalf("expected catalog identity snapshot, got %#v", created)
	}
}

func TestStudentPracticeTaskRuntimeUsesPinnedRevision(t *testing.T) {
	useCase := StudentUseCase{
		Catalog: materializationCatalogStub{
			revisionID: "revision-2",
			runtimeContext: domain.PracticeTaskRuntimeContext{
				RevisionID:     "revision-2",
				RevisionNumber: 2,
			},
		},
	}

	runtimeContext, err := useCase.getStudentPracticeTaskRuntimeContext(context.Background(), &domain.StudentPracticeTask{
		PracticeTaskID:         "practice-task",
		PracticeTaskRevisionID: "revision-2",
	})
	if err != nil {
		t.Fatalf("get pinned runtime context: %v", err)
	}
	if runtimeContext.RevisionID != "revision-2" || runtimeContext.RevisionNumber != 2 {
		t.Fatalf("expected pinned revision, got %#v", runtimeContext)
	}
}

func TestStudentPracticeTaskRuntimeKeepsPinnedSolutionVariant(t *testing.T) {
	useCase := StudentUseCase{
		Catalog: materializationCatalogStub{
			revisionID: "revision-2",
			runtimeContext: domain.PracticeTaskRuntimeContext{
				RevisionID: "revision-2",
				PracticeTask: domain.PracticeTask{Stacks: []domain.PracticeTaskStack{
					{StackCode: "html"},
					{StackCode: "react"},
				}},
				SolutionVariants: []domain.PracticeTaskRuntimeVariant{
					{ID: "variant-html", StackCodes: []string{"html"}, MilestoneIDs: []string{"html-milestone"}, IsActive: true},
					{
						ID:         "variant-react",
						StackCodes: []string{"react"},
						IsActive:   true,
						MilestoneBindings: []domain.PracticeTaskRuntimeVariantMilestone{{
							PracticeTaskPartMilestoneID: "react-milestone",
							IsRequired:                  true,
							LessonBindings: []domain.PracticeTaskRuntimeLessonBinding{{
								CourseID:         "react-course",
								LessonID:         "react-lesson",
								Requirement:      domain.PracticeTaskLessonRequirementRequired,
								StepTitle:        "Build component",
								StepInstructions: "Apply the lesson.",
							}},
						}},
					},
				},
				PracticeTaskMilestones: []domain.PracticeTaskRuntimeMilestone{
					{ID: "html-milestone", IsActive: true},
					{ID: "react-milestone", IsActive: true},
				},
			},
		},
	}

	runtimeContext, err := useCase.getStudentPracticeTaskRuntimeContext(context.Background(), &domain.StudentPracticeTask{
		PracticeTaskID:                "practice-task",
		PracticeTaskRevisionID:        "revision-2",
		PracticeTaskSolutionVariantID: "variant-react",
	})
	if err != nil {
		t.Fatalf("get pinned variant runtime context: %v", err)
	}
	if len(runtimeContext.PracticeTaskMilestones) != 1 || runtimeContext.PracticeTaskMilestones[0].ID != "react-milestone" {
		t.Fatalf("expected only pinned react milestone, got %#v", runtimeContext.PracticeTaskMilestones)
	}
	if len(runtimeContext.PracticeTask.Stacks) != 1 || runtimeContext.PracticeTask.Stacks[0].StackCode != "react" {
		t.Fatalf("expected only pinned react stack, got %#v", runtimeContext.PracticeTask.Stacks)
	}
	if len(runtimeContext.PracticeTaskMilestones[0].LessonBindings) != 1 || runtimeContext.PracticeTaskMilestones[0].LessonBindings[0].LessonID != "react-lesson" {
		t.Fatalf("expected pinned lesson route, got %#v", runtimeContext.PracticeTaskMilestones[0].LessonBindings)
	}
}

func TestCreateStudentPracticeTaskRejectsRuntimeWithoutActiveMilestones(t *testing.T) {
	useCase := StudentUseCase{
		Catalog: materializationCatalogStub{runtimeContext: domain.PracticeTaskRuntimeContext{
			PracticeTaskMilestones: []domain.PracticeTaskRuntimeMilestone{{ID: "inactive", IsActive: false}},
		}},
		Students: &materializationRepositoryStub{},
	}

	_, err := useCase.CreateStudentPracticeTask(context.Background(), "student", "practice-task", "")
	if !errors.Is(err, domain.ErrValidation) {
		t.Fatalf("expected validation error, got %v", err)
	}
}

func TestCreateStudentPracticeTaskRejectsActiveMilestoneWithoutCatalogIdentity(t *testing.T) {
	useCase := StudentUseCase{
		Catalog: materializationCatalogStub{runtimeContext: domain.PracticeTaskRuntimeContext{
			PracticeTaskMilestones: []domain.PracticeTaskRuntimeMilestone{{ID: "part-milestone", IsActive: true}},
		}},
		Students: &materializationRepositoryStub{},
	}

	_, err := useCase.CreateStudentPracticeTask(context.Background(), "student", "practice-task", "")
	if !errors.Is(err, domain.ErrValidation) {
		t.Fatalf("expected validation error, got %v", err)
	}
}

func TestCreateStudentPracticeTaskRequiresChoiceWhenRevisionHasMultipleVariants(t *testing.T) {
	useCase := StudentUseCase{
		Catalog: materializationCatalogStub{runtimeContext: domain.PracticeTaskRuntimeContext{
			RevisionID: "revision-1",
			SolutionVariants: []domain.PracticeTaskRuntimeVariant{
				{ID: "variant-html", IsActive: true, MilestoneIDs: []string{"html-milestone"}},
				{ID: "variant-react", IsActive: true, MilestoneIDs: []string{"react-milestone"}},
			},
			PracticeTaskMilestones: []domain.PracticeTaskRuntimeMilestone{
				{ID: "html-milestone", PracticeTaskPartID: "html-part", PracticeTaskMilestoneID: "html-definition", IsActive: true},
				{ID: "react-milestone", PracticeTaskPartID: "react-part", PracticeTaskMilestoneID: "react-definition", IsActive: true},
			},
		}},
		Students: &materializationRepositoryStub{},
	}

	_, err := useCase.CreateStudentPracticeTask(context.Background(), "student", "practice-task", "")
	if !errors.Is(err, domain.ErrValidation) {
		t.Fatalf("expected variant choice validation error, got %v", err)
	}
}

func TestCreateStudentPracticeTaskMaterializesOnlySelectedVariantMilestones(t *testing.T) {
	repositoryStub := &materializationRepositoryStub{}
	useCase := StudentUseCase{
		Catalog: materializationCatalogStub{runtimeContext: domain.PracticeTaskRuntimeContext{
			RevisionID: "revision-1",
			SolutionVariants: []domain.PracticeTaskRuntimeVariant{
				{ID: "variant-html", IsActive: true, MilestoneIDs: []string{"html-milestone"}},
				{ID: "variant-react", IsActive: true, MilestoneIDs: []string{"react-milestone"}},
			},
			PracticeTaskMilestones: []domain.PracticeTaskRuntimeMilestone{
				{ID: "html-milestone", PracticeTaskPartID: "html-part", PracticeTaskMilestoneID: "html-definition", IsActive: true},
				{ID: "react-milestone", PracticeTaskPartID: "react-part", PracticeTaskMilestoneID: "react-definition", IsActive: true},
			},
		}},
		Students: repositoryStub,
	}

	_, err := useCase.CreateStudentPracticeTask(context.Background(), "student", "practice-task", "variant-react")
	if err != nil {
		t.Fatalf("create selected variant: %v", err)
	}
	if len(repositoryStub.createdMilestones) != 1 || repositoryStub.createdMilestones[0].PracticeTaskPartMilestoneID != "react-milestone" {
		t.Fatalf("expected only react milestone, got %#v", repositoryStub.createdMilestones)
	}
}

func TestStorefrontProgressiveVariantsMaterializeOneTwoAndThreeMilestones(t *testing.T) {
	runtime := domain.PracticeTaskRuntimeContext{
		RevisionID: "storefront-revision-1",
		SolutionVariants: []domain.PracticeTaskRuntimeVariant{
			{ID: "storefront-html", Code: "html", IsActive: true, MilestoneIDs: []string{"html"}},
			{ID: "storefront-html-css", Code: "html-css", IsActive: true, MilestoneIDs: []string{"html", "css"}},
			{ID: "storefront-html-css-js", Code: "html-css-js", IsActive: true, MilestoneIDs: []string{"html", "css", "javascript"}},
		},
		PracticeTaskMilestones: []domain.PracticeTaskRuntimeMilestone{
			{ID: "html", PracticeTaskPartID: "catalog", PracticeTaskMilestoneID: "html-definition", IsActive: true},
			{ID: "css", PracticeTaskPartID: "catalog", PracticeTaskMilestoneID: "css-definition", IsActive: true},
			{ID: "javascript", PracticeTaskPartID: "catalog", PracticeTaskMilestoneID: "javascript-definition", IsActive: true},
		},
	}
	for _, testCase := range []struct {
		variantID string
		expected  int
	}{
		{variantID: "storefront-html", expected: 1},
		{variantID: "storefront-html-css", expected: 2},
		{variantID: "storefront-html-css-js", expected: 3},
	} {
		t.Run(testCase.variantID, func(t *testing.T) {
			repositoryStub := &materializationRepositoryStub{}
			useCase := StudentUseCase{Catalog: materializationCatalogStub{runtimeContext: runtime}, Students: repositoryStub}
			_, err := useCase.CreateStudentPracticeTask(context.Background(), "student", "storefront-lite", testCase.variantID)
			if err != nil {
				t.Fatalf("create progressive variant: %v", err)
			}
			if len(repositoryStub.createdMilestones) != testCase.expected {
				t.Fatalf("expected %d materialized milestones, got %#v", testCase.expected, repositoryStub.createdMilestones)
			}
			if repositoryStub.createdProject.PracticeTaskRevisionID != "storefront-revision-1" || repositoryStub.createdProject.PracticeTaskSolutionVariantID != testCase.variantID {
				t.Fatalf("expected exact revision and variant pin, got %#v", repositoryStub.createdProject)
			}
		})
	}
}
